scope: Nine standard action rows only, 57 used frames, current registered standard atlas and actual GIF previews; excludes look directions, final despill/chroma signoff, packaging and app import.

minor_issues.issue: The trailing leg stays noticeably bent and elevated through several stride phases rather than passing closely under the body.
minor_issues.judgment: Minor stylized gait. Left-facing silhouette and alternating extended lead/support legs are clear, feet retain a grounded support phase, torso remains upright, and no directional reversal or frozen stride is visible. Does not block standard-action acceptance.

evidence.actual_gif_playback: Headless installed Google Chrome through bundled Playwright, nine 192x208 GIFs in 3x3 grid, screenshots at 330ms intervals after images loaded.
evidence.decoded_loop_check: All nine actual GIF files decoded in order; frame counts, unique frames, positive timing, infinite-loop metadata checked. Native-size sequence sheets for idle, running-left, jumping inspected in addition to atlas and timed playback snapshots.

checks.identity_props_proportions: pass: same pale silver-green long hair, lavender eyes, blue/gold pointed mage hat, blue/gold coat, white layered skirt, diagonal brown strap and brown boots. No missing costume element, new prop, extra limb, obvious body deformation or conspicuous scale popping.
checks.clipping_slot_overlap: pass: every hat, hair tip, hand, coat and boot remains inside its frame; no adjacent-pose overlap.
checks.interior_transparency: pass by visual inspection of all native cells: no accidental horizontal gaps or filled-body holes seen. Expected openings between arms/coat and legs remain intentional negative space.
checks.forbidden_effects: pass: no detached marks, stars, speed lines, dust, floor shadows or new review props.
checks.loop_and_registration: pass: 57 distinct nonblank GIF frames across nine states, valid positive durations and loop=0; repeated near-contact travel phases support cyclic cadence. Jump returns to stance, hand/expression states return to a quiet pose without an obvious anatomy/scale snap.
checks.chroma: not assessed here: current standard previews are pre-final-despill; final cleanup report and final atlas validation own chroma acceptance.

states.observed: Quiet planted pose with slight eyelid variation and a full closed-eye blink in frame 2, minimal body change; not a duplicated static row or active gesture.
Nose/face and chest point screen-right. Extended and passing feet alternate, including opposite lead legs in frames 0 and 2 and repeated cyclic support phases. Short grounded strides, no reversal.

Face and chest point screen-left, hair trails right. Opposite feet visibly lead across frames 0 and 2/6; near phases 1/3/5/7 alternate support. Bent raised trailing knee gives a jaunty walk but does not prevent readable leftward alternating travel.
Raised open hand in frames 1-2 and smiling face read as a wave; frame 0/3 hands relax. No detached wave marks.
Stance, crouch, upward light hop with both boots lifted at peak frame 2, crouch recovery, stance. Full body stays visible; no landing effects.
Drooping eyelids, hands down/in front, uncertain hand near head and closed-eye lowered expression read as mild disappointment/fluster rather than idle.
Hand held forward/up toward viewer, head tilt and brief friendly closed-eye smile form an expectant requesting-input pose, distinct from chin-rest review and passive idle.
Feet remain planted; hands draw together at chest with focused downward eyes and closed-eye effort, then relax. Reads as working/thinking without literal foot-running.
Hand against chin/cheek, thoughtful head lean and upright checking glance read as scrutiny/review. No added paper, magnifier or UI prop.

not_verified: Real-time continuous human video observation; evidence is ordered decoded frames plus timed actual playback snapshots
